claim: Blood draws the far side of a room-over-room floor or ceiling only if that surface wears a mirror tile (or has the 0x180 stat bits); an ordinary floor over a linked sector is drawn as itself.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/mirrors.cpp:243 IsRorSector: mirrorPicStart..mirrorPicEnd, kMirrorTile or floorstat & 0x180
use: Give both halves of a see-through link the mirror tile; the rules_blood rule stack-portal-wears-the-mirror-tile reports a portal that does not.
